thread:
Nina (AE): quick one 10 — Customer (BrightLeaf EU Ltd) wants to convert POC -> PO. They want signer from Irish sub and an HSM attestation clause. Need legal/finance on POA, VAT, and whether attestation can be scoped to Dedicated/BYO-HSM.

Theo (Legal): paste the exact redline? if attestation is a condition precedent to payment that's a no-go. Also list acceptable POA types.

Nina (AE): redline excerpt: 

`Section 6.3: "Provider will provide written attestation of HSM model and key custody within 10 business days of execution. Failure to provide attestation entitles Customer to withhold payment."`

Ravi (Security): we can't accept withholding of payment tied to attestation. We can support HSM attestation for Private or Dedicated with BYO-HSM; timeline is 30-60 days and may require an SOW. Hosted tier = no third-party HSM attestation.

Marta (FinOps): operationally: confirm billing entity and PO number. For Irish invoicing VAT applies unless they provide VAT reg. Also we need a notarized POA or eIDAS proof if signer is not on company letterhead. Net30 typical.

Theo (Legal): propose counter-language: remove payment-withhold, instead: "Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide a scoped HSM attestation for Private/Dedicated deployments; timeline and fees (if any) to be set forth in an SOW. Hosted plans do not include HSM attestations." Add acceptable POA list: notarized POA, eIDAS advanced, or corporate resolution + ID.

Nina (AE): I'll push that and ask BrightLeaf for PO#, VAT reg, preferred signer, and attach their POA. I'll also flag that attestation may need SOW.

esig-bot: Envelope created (env_bright_01) for Order Form + MSA addendum 10 awaiting signatures.

Marta (FinOps): OK from finance once PO# and billing entity match. If they want invoice to holding co, need written consent from counterparty legal.

Ravi (Security): please cc product-ops if they confirm attestation so we can scope the runbook.

Theo (Legal): thanks 10 I'll prepare addendum with POA checklist and the deployment-limited attestation carve-out. Nina 10 target signature date?

Nina (AE): aiming EOW; pinging procurement off-thread now. :thumbsup:
